note: Learn is now a window onto the independent knowledge commons (brief: docs/wip/knowledge-commons/Commons_AA_BuildBrief_v0_2.md §17). The opening text is Claude's draft for Karl's edit. The Ask box calls Holon through the commons' public interface. The example questions are Claude's drafts.
opening: A knowledge commons on what we know about living, complex adaptive systems, including human societies, and what helps them flourish.

Abundance Architecture started it, but it stands on its own: openly licensed, kept in a public repository anyone can copy, run on its own infrastructure, and governed by the people who contribute to it. Abundance Architecture is one place where its knowledge is shared, debated and put to use.
Ask Holon, the commons' AI agent. Every answer shows its sources, how well the evidence supports each claim, and the strongest objection.
askLabel: What would you like to understand?
examplesHeading: New here? Start with one of these
exampleQuestions: Why do I work harder and still feel I am falling behind?
Why is health care built around treating illness?
Teach me what a complex adaptive system is
What is the strongest argument against this site?
disclosure: Answers are written by Holon, the commons' AI agent, from what the commons holds. They can be wrong, so check the sources. When the commons does not cover something, Holon says so and records what was missing, never your words, unless you choose to share your question. Your questions are private and never used to train any model; during this draft they are kept so the commons' stewards can review how Holon behaves.
